_meta.title: SLC Health Inspection Ontology (data-grounded v1)
purpose: Tag ingested SLCHD facts and (later) RAG chunks with concept labels
Ground hypothesis generation and evidence lookup for the MVP agent
Expose a structure the agent can cite when explaining reasoning (RQ2)

slc_violations.grain: one row per violation line item on an inspection

Establishment.description: A licensed food-service premises in the SLCHD public portal. Broader than 'restaurant' — includes caterers, coffee shops, mobile units, commissaries.

establishment_key.description: Composite key: NAME|ADDRESS|CITY (uppercased). Not an official permit ID.

establishment_type.description: SLCHD license category (e.g. 'Restaurants: plated', 'Mobiles: Food Carts').

rank.description: Portal compliance rank as percentage string (e.g. '89%').

EstablishmentType.description: Normalized license category for an Establishment.

ComplianceRank.description: Portal-reported compliance percentile for an establishment (75–100% in current sample). Distinct from per-inspection violation score.

Inspection.description: A single health inspection event. Lower score = fewer violation points (0 = clean).

name.note: Denormalized from portal; prefer establishment_key for joins.

score.description: Total violation points for this inspection. 0 means no points assessed.

critical_violations.description: Summary count from portal; often null when score is 0.

noncritical_violations.description: Summary count from portal; often null when score is 0.

Violation.description: One cited violation line on an inspection. Structured code + rubric category + free-text observation.

code.description: Utah Food Code section reference (e.g. '4.6.40', '4.4.82*'). Asterisk often marks critical items.

points.description: Per-violation points when present; mostly null — prefer Inspection.score.

occurrences.description: Repeat count of this violation within the inspection (usually 1).

phr.description: Public health rationale. 160 distinct values in sample.

ViolationCategory.description: Raw rubric label from the portal (Violation.phr). Kept as-is for traceability; map to ViolationType for reasoning.

ViolationType.description: Normalized violation bucket for agent reasoning. Populated via hand-curated semantic/violation_map.csv keyed on code and/or phr.

risk_level.derivation: Prefer Violation.critical; corroborate with code/phr asterisk markers.

mapping_notes: 161 distinct codes and 160 phr labels in sample — map top-frequency codes first.

InspectionTrend.description: Derived trend over available inspection history for an establishment.

derivation.score_delta: last_score - first_score by inspection_date within establishment window

Hypothesis.description: Candidate explanation the agent generates before recommending or warning about an establishment.

Evidence.description: A traceable fact or retrieved chunk cited for or against a Hypothesis.

fact_tables._target: DuckDB views over parquet emitted by etl/

hypothesis_evidence_map._note: Analytical guidance scoped to SLCHD data available now. Expand when reviews/RAG sources land.

look_for: Inspection.score: recent values low (0–3), stable over window
ViolationType: temperature_control or cross_contamination with risk_level=critical
Inspection.score: elevated on most recent visit
Violation.occurrences: > 1 for same code on one inspection
Inspection.inspection_type: follow-up after prior violations with lower score
Violation.critical: increasing count or new critical codes
Inspection.score: upward trend across last 3 inspections
Violation.code: same critical code on multiple inspection dates
Violation.cos: No on critical items (not corrected on site)
Inspection.inspection_type: '07 - Critical Item' or '02 - Followup' present

data_quality_flags.sparse_violation_points: Violation.points null for most rows; use Inspection.score instead.
data_quality_flags.zero_violation_rows: Some establishments have inspections but no violation rows — treat as clean history.
data_quality_flags.composite_key: establishment_key can split multi-location brands; do not infer sibling groups without external data.
